errors.text_span: including “Average,” “GPT-40,” “GPT-4-turbo,” “Claude 3.5 mini,” “Claude 3.5 Sonnet,” “Gemini 1.5 Pro,” “Llama-3.1-40B,” “Mistral Large,” “DeepSeek-V3,” “Qwen-4-Plus,” and “GLM-4-Plus,”
errors.evidence: The list of models is incomplete and contains numerous errors. It omits "Claude 3 Opus" and "Claude 3.5 Haiku". It misnames several models, such as "GPT-40" (should be "GPT-4o"), "Claude 3.5 mini" (should be "GPT-4o-mini"), "Llama-3.1-40B" (should be "Llama-3.1-405B"), and "Qwen-4-Plus" (should be "Qwen-Max").
The models on the horizontal axis are not ordered alphabetically. For example, 'G' (GPT-4o) appears before 'C' (Claude 3 Opus).
The vertical axis is labeled “Expert Win Rate (%)”, not “Win Rate (%)”.
The tick intervals on the vertical axis are 20%, not 10% (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100).

errors.text_span: The tallest bar, representing the “Average” LLM, has a value of 97.67%
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The tallest bar is for "GPT-4o-mini" with a value of 97.56%. The "Average" bar is not the tallest and has a value of 88.89%. The value 97.67% is not present in the chart.

errors.text_span: the shortest bar, “Qwen-4-Plus,” displays a win rate of 82.26%
errors.evidence: This incorrectly identifies the shortest bar. The shortest bar is for "DeepSeek-V3" at 82.26%. The model "Qwen-Max" (mislabeled as "Qwen-4-Plus") has a win rate of 85.07%.
The description fails to mention that the x-axis label "Average" is colored red, which is a form of visual emphasis.
